article_title: 'I live with a ghost': Japan's haunted homes attract bargain hunters

tasks.prompt: What broader change in Japan's housing market does the article describe?
options: Only foreign residents may rent incident properties.
Rising costs are making discounted stigmatised homes more attractive.
Estate agents are refusing to disclose deaths in homes.
Haunted homes now sell for more than ordinary homes.
tasks.correct_answer: Rising costs are making discounted stigmatised homes more attractive.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת כיצד עליית מחירי הדיור ויוקר המחיה הופכות נכסים מוכתמים וזולים לאטרקטיביים יותר.

tasks.prompt: How much rent does Ryua pay each month for her Tokyo apartment?
options: 20 million yen
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ריוּאה משלמת 45,000 ין בחודש במקום כ־62,000 ין.

tasks.prompt: Under Japan's 2021 guidelines, how long must relevant deaths be disclosed for rental properties?
options: Only until the first new tenant moves in
For one year
For three years
Indefinitely in every rental case
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בנכסים להשכרה יש לחשוף את המידע במשך שלוש שנים; במכירה החשיפה נדרשת ללא הגבלת זמן.

tasks.prompt: What does “stigmatised” mean in the phrase “stigmatised properties”?
options: Newly built with government support
Marked negatively because of a troubling past
Protected as historic buildings
Shared by several unrelated tenants
tasks.correct_answer: Marked negatively because of a troubling past
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר הכתבה, נכס stigmatised הוא נכס שדבק בו מוניטין שלילי בגלל מוות או אירוע קשה.

tasks.prompt: Why was Diane Tincher able to buy her rural house at a large discount?
options: The house had no garden or bedrooms.
An elderly woman had died there alone.
The property was damaged by fire.
The estate agent concealed its location.
tasks.correct_answer: An elderly woman had died there alone.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מותה הבודד של אישה מבוגרת בבית הפך אותו לנכס מוכתם והוביל להנחה גדולה.

tasks.prompt: What is distinctive about the Oshimaland website?
options: It lists incident properties using details added by members of the public.
It guarantees that every listed home is free of ghosts.
It sells only newly built apartments in Tokyo.
It sets Japan's legal disclosure rules.
tasks.correct_answer: It lists incident properties using details added by members of the public.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Oshimaland הוא אתר במיקור המונים: הציבור מוסיף נכסים ופרטים על האירועים שהתרחשו בהם.

tasks.prompt: Compare Ryua's and Diane Tincher's housing bargains using at least one figure for each.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין שתי העסקאות ולשלב נתון מספרי מדויק לכל אחת.
expected_points: Ryua receives almost a 30% rent discount, paying 45,000 yen instead of 62,000 yen.
Tincher paid 20 million yen for a house where similar homes can cost up to 45 million yen.
Both discounts were linked to deaths associated with the properties.

tasks.prompt: What does the 2025 survey suggest about Japanese attitudes to jiko bukken, and what economic factor may explain the change?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה לשלב את ממצא הסקר עם הסבר כלכלי מהכתבה.
expected_points: More than half of respondents would rent a jiko bukken if it were cheap.
This suggests price can outweigh superstition for many people.
Rising house prices and the wider cost of living make discounts more appealing.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how beliefs, disclosure rules and housing costs interact in Japan's market for jiko bukken.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין אמונות תרבותיות, חובת גילוי והנחות במחיר.
expected_points: Deaths or tragic events can stigmatise a property because many people fear troubled spirits.
Estate agents must disclose specified deaths for set periods or indefinitely when selling.
Lower prices attract bargain hunters, especially as housing and living costs rise.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, write a balanced paragraph on whether you would consider living in a jiko bukken.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הפסקה צריכה להציג עמדה מנומקת ולהשתמש לפחות בשתי ראיות מהכתבה.
expected_points: Use concrete evidence such as Ryua's rent discount, Tincher's purchase price or the disclosure rules.
Acknowledge a counterargument involving superstition, comfort or affordability.
